leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply @supports to test for CSS property support in a stylesheet
Construct conditional CSS rules that only execute when specific features are supported
Configure fallback styles using @supports to maintain compatibility across browsers
Implement @supports with logical operators (and, or, not) to test multiple features
Manipulate layout behavior by applying @supports to control advanced CSS features
Integrate @supports with modern CSS properties to progressively enhance designs
Update existing CSS code to include @supports for better cross-browser support
